Dwarven Resilience. Augrek has advantage on saving throws 
against poison. 
ACTIONS 
Warhammer. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 6 (ld8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (ldlO + 2) 
bludgeoning damage if used with two hands. 
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 
100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (ldlO) piercing damage. Augrek 
carries ten crossbow bolts. 
ROLEPLAYING INFORMATION 
Sheriff's deputy Augrek guards the southwest gate of Bryn 
Shander and welcomes visitors to town. She has a good heart. 
Ideal: "You'll get farther in life with a kind word than an axe." 
1 Bond: "Bryn Shander is my home. It's my job to protect her." 
Flaw: "I'm head over heels in love with Sheriff Southwell. One 
day I hope to marry him."

Shortsword. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 6 (ld6 + 3) piercing damage. 
Dart. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one 
target. Hit: 5 (ld4 + 3) piercing damage. Sirac carries six darts. 
REACTIONS 
Parry. Sirac adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that 
would hit him. To do so, Sirac must see the attacker and be 
wielding a melee weapon. 
ROLEPLAYING INFORMATION 
An acolyte ofTorm, Sirac grew up on the streets ofSuzail, the 
capital of Cormyr. He came to lcewind Dale to become a knuck
lehead trout fisher but instead found religion. The misbegotten 
son of Artus Cimber, a renowned human adventurer, Sirac 
hasn't seen his father since he was a baby. 
Ideal: "Without duty or loyalty, a man is nothing." 
Bond: "lcewind Dale is where I belong for the rest of my life." 
Flaw: "I am honest to a fault."
